metadata.name: compartido_market
metadata.description: Private collaborative demand market built for MagicBlock Solana Blitz v7

instructions.name: claim_room_access
docs: The wallet that proves knowledge of a one-time link secret receives its
role onchain. The secret is never persisted, only its hash.

instructions.name: compute_allocations
docs: Computes allocations inside the Private ER. Remaining accounts must be
ordered as `(public commitment, ER-only private budget)` pairs. Only the
outcome is written into delegated public state; private maxima stay in
their ER-only accounts and are never committed to Solana.

instructions.name: create_bid
docs: Creates a public commitment and escrows against the campaign-wide safety
ceiling. A buyer's real maximum never appears in this account.

instructions.name: create_claimable_invite
docs: Creates a one-time capability link. The recipient's wallet is deliberately
unknown here: it is bound only when the recipient claims the secret.

instructions.name: delegate_campaign
docs: Delegates the public campaign only after a supplier has been selected so
private allocation can update the aggregate outcome inside the ER.

instructions.name: grant_room_access
docs: The organizer grants a wallet one explicit role before sharing its invite.

instructions.name: init_bid_permission
docs: Creates a private permission on the ER. Only this buyer can inspect the
bid PDA through the TEE endpoint.

instructions.name: init_private_budget_permission
docs: Restricts the ER-only budget to its owner and the room organizer. Other
participants can observe aggregate progress but cannot query this account.

instructions.name: place_private_budget
docs: Creates the secret budget PDA directly inside the Private ER. Unlike a
delegated base-layer account, an `eph` account has no public state to leak.

instructions.name: select_winning_offer
docs: Every offer must be passed, preventing callers from hiding a cheaper supplier.

instructions.name: settle_campaign
docs: Pays the selected supplier from public, committed allocation outcomes.

instructions.name: update_private_budget
docs: Lets a participant revise their secret ceiling before the room closes.
The private account remains inside the TEE and its permission is unchanged.
